title: fix(ui): record:path uses the compact path in a narrow record drawer, keyed on its own width (#34696)
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg2evNa1V3zxrQq3KX

Fixes #34696

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：阶段路径（`record:path`）的桌面行 / 紧凑路径切换，从只看视口改为「视口 ≥ sm 且路径自身宽度 ≥ 24rem」才画桌面行，否则画 #34595 的紧凑路径。
- 为什么改：1280px 视口下打开 380px 记录抽屉时，七个阶段各只剩约 33px，标签被截成一个字母，销售在抽屉里看不出商机处在哪一步。
- 风险与回滚：纯 CSS（Tailwind 容器查询），无元数据、无新 prop、无新文案；宽路径（900/1200px）的桌面行与旧切换逐像素一致（e2e fixture 对照实测）。阈值依据「最窄整页约 464px」是读样式类推算的，未在运行中的 Console 实测。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`（根 `@container` 与两行的 `sm:@sm:` 类）；`ui/e2e/record-path-narrow-drawer-34696.spec.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.compact-34595.test.tsx`，预期 10 条全绿（含「根是两行共同查询的容器」「两行都不再只按视口切换」）；几何见 CI 的 Build & E2E UI 里 `record-path-narrow-drawer-34696.spec.ts` 的 6 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `record-path.tsx`: the path's root is now a Tailwind `@container`, and each row stacks the viewport variant on a container variant. The desktop row is `hidden sm:@sm:flex` (was `hidden sm:flex`); the compact path is `sm:@sm:hidden` (was `sm:hidden`). So the desktop row draws only when the viewport is at least `sm` AND the path itself is at least `@sm` (24rem, 384 px) wide; otherwise the compact path from #34595 draws.
- Below `sm` nothing changes: the compact path, whatever the path's width.
- **Pattern followed:** Tailwind container queries, as `HeaderHighlight.tsx` (`@container` + `@lg:grid-cols-3`) and `DetailSection.tsx` (`@container` + `@sm:grid-cols-2`) do in the same package. Not the `ResizeObserver` measure of `RecordTabRow.tsx` / `RelatedList.tsx`: those measure *overflow*, which CSS cannot express; this decision is a pure width threshold, so CSS gets it right on the first paint, with no state, no re-render and nothing for jsdom to fake.
- **Threshold:** 24rem. Reasoning, READ from classes and NOT measured in a running Console: at or above `sm`, the narrowest full-width record page should be a 768 px viewport beside the expanded `16rem` sidebar (`SIDEBAR_WIDTH`), inside the layout shell's `md:p-6`, so about 464 px before any inner padding, above 384. A 380 px drawer (the drawer's documented floor is 360 px) gives the path at most 380 px, under 384. `@md` (28rem, 448 px) was rejected because it sits only 16 px under that estimate. MEASURED (fixture, Chromium): 360 px and 380 px paths at a 1280 px viewport draw the compact path; 900 px and 1200 px paths draw the desktop row, pixel-identical to the old switch.
- Tests: two existing assertions that pinned the viewport-only class names (`record-path.compact-34595.test.tsx`, `record-path.phoneRow-26897.test.tsx`) now pin the stacked names, citing #34696; a new top-level `describe` in `record-path.compact-34595.test.tsx` pins that the root is the container both rows query and that neither row switches on the viewport alone. `e2e/record-path-phone-row.spec.ts` now grabs the compact class by its new token.
- New `ui/e2e/record-path-narrow-drawer-34696.spec.ts`: Chromium geometry with real Tailwind compiled for the classes read out of `record-path.tsx`.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

## Why

#34614's acceptance 1 asks that a 380 px drawer show no label cut to one letter. The ~33 px labels reading 'P…', 'Pro…', 'Ne…' were measured by o3-A on the real record drawer (os-dev report 6941211681 on #34614); this run did NOT re-measure the real drawer.

Premise lines, measured by this run:

- **Cause (read at origin/main `77b42a1ed0`, unchanged at `f6f5b50a05`):** `record-path.tsx` switched by viewport only: the desktop row's class `hidden sm:flex w-full items-start gap-2`, stages `flex-1 min-w-0`, ordinary labels `text-center truncate`; the compact block's class `sm:hidden w-full`. Holds. Correction: the card spells the compact class `flex sm:hidden` and its line addresses predate #34684; the substance is unchanged.
- **Repro (fixture, Chromium, real Tailwind, 1280 px viewport, desktop row forced on in a 380 px path):** every ordinary stage gets under 50 px (Prospecting 46.84 px) and Prospecting, Qualification, Needs Analysis and Negotiation are cut; Proposal fits whole. So in a bare 380 px path the cut is to a few letters; the card's one-letter cut matches a narrower path (the drawer body's own padding), which this run did not measure.
- **Prior rulings:** `node scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 34696 --terms 'container query,@container,narrow drawer,record path,record-path,viewport,breakpoint'` at `f6f5b50a05`: 1 hit, ADR-0065 Decision §2 ("Authors never write breakpoint variant classes"). It rules on author-written metadata styling; this diff changes renderer-internal classes and no metadata, so it does not apply. Card thread: 0 rulings.
- **Reach:** the Console's record drawer at a desktop viewport, per the card and o3-A's report; not re-measured live by this run.

Run after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --concurrency=2` (BUILD_EXIT=0), on a tree whose package files are byte-identical to the head (later commits touch only the changeset and the e2e spec).
</details>

<details><summary>E2E: the new spec and the phone-row spec, Chromium</summary>

```
$ pnpm exec playwright test (scratch config: the two specs, chromium, /opt/pw-browsers/chromium)
  ✓ record-path-phone-row.spec.ts: 320px / 375px / 390px, long name wraps, twenty-stage path (5)
  ✓ the defect this pins: at 380px the desktop row gives each stage under 50px and cuts the long names
  ✓ a 360px drawer at a 1280px viewport draws the compact path, the current stage whole
  ✓ a 380px drawer at a 1280px viewport draws the compact path, the current stage whole
  ✓ a viewport below `sm` keeps the compact path even in a path wider than `@sm`
  ✓ CONTROL — a 900px path at a 1280px viewport draws the desktop row, every label readable
  ✓ CONTROL — the wide desktop row is pixel-identical to the viewport-only switch it replaces

os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

The pixel-identity control renders the same fixture twice, once with the old classes (`hidden sm:flex` / `sm:hidden`, no container) and once with the new, at 900 px and 1200 px paths, and asserts every label's width, top and left are equal. The defect leg forces the desktop row on at 380 px so the narrow-drawer legs are not vacuous.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one pin)</summary>

Mutation: drop `@container` from the root (`cn('@container w-full', className)` to `cn('w-full', className)`), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`.

```

     × the root is the container both rows query, with no container between
      Tests  1 failed | 9 passed (10)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (f8facc48df88) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1: a 380 px (and a 360 px) path at a 1280 px viewport draws the compact path; the current stage's name is whole. Acceptance 2: the wide desktop row is pinned pixel-identical to the old switch. Acceptance 3: `ui/e2e/record-path-narrow-drawer-34696.spec.ts`.
- A path between 384 px and about 448 px at a desktop viewport still draws the desktop row, as it always did, with stage labels around 48 px (a few letters and an ellipsis). That is the pre-existing look of a narrow full-width page and is unchanged on purpose.
- NOT MEASURED: the threshold argument (the narrowest full-width page) is read from the shell's classes, not measured in a running Console; the real drawer was not opened in a running Console either.
